content:
drew: quick sanity check — we plan an evening model-sweep 22:00 PT (~2h window). expecting ~10 A100s in us-central1 for parallel load tests. any quota holes or vendor ETA risks we should know now?

sana: tagging vendor-ops, can you confirm pool availability and whether we can pre-lock capacity or reserve ephemeral slices? :eyes:

vendor-ops: we have a soft standby of 12 A100s in us-central1 but two racks are on provisional holds until the billing PO clears. ETA to clear is 90–120m if finance approves. fallback would be spot-burst (higher eviction risk).

liao: thanks — if finance might delay, can we shift some load to us-west2 H100s instead? would need ~6 H100s, nothing fancy. perf curve will differ though.

ashley: finance pinged earlier; PO 5791 is in approval pipeline. i can nudge them, but ETA ~45m optimistic.

vendor-ops: noted, if PO not approved we'll open a short-term reserved commit for the 10 A100s and invoice after. need confirmation by 21:30 PT to guarantee.

oncall-bot: Incident check: no active capacity incidents in us-central1 in the last 24h.

drew: ok — action items: (1) ashley to nudge finance (21:00 PT), (2) vendor-ops to hold standby until 21:30 PT, (3) liao prepare a minimal-sweep config to run on H100s if we need the failover.

liao: prepping a lightweight tfvars and a runner. snippet for switching region in the infra config:

```
# infra/overrides/sweep.tfvars
region = "us-west2"
gpu_type = "h100"
instance_count = 6
```

liao: will open PR with the config and smoke test job. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/PR-3621 (will tag @drew)

drew: perfect. ashley — if you can ping finance before 21:00 PT i'll lock the reserved commit. otherwise i'll flip to the H100 failover at 21:35 and start the sweep at 22:00 PT. thanks all :thumbsup:
